text:
Google acquired Wiz in March 2025 to close the security gap with competitors AWS and Azure, positioning cloud-security consolidation as a key battleground in the ongoing "cloud wars" [Source: ev-1]. The deal signaled that Google was betting on AI-driven cloud adoption as the primary demand driver for these services [Source: ev-1].

The acquisition was announced on 2025-03-18 for approximately $32 billion in an all-cash transaction, which marked the largest acquisition in Google's history [Source: ev-1]. This final price followed Wiz’s rejection of an earlier offer from Google worth $23 billion in July 2024 [Source: ev-1].
